WHAT IS A PSI UPSILON CONVENTION?

The Convention is the legislative body of the frater
nity. Delegates from each undergraduate chapter and
alumni association travel from all over the United States
and Canada to meet annually to discuss and take action
on the important issues facing the fraternity in the
year
ahead. In addition, a significant portion of Convention
time is devoted to educational sessions on such topics as
alumni relations, social programming, hazing, etc. This
year's schedule also includes special presentations by two
nationally recognized authorities, one on Thursday eve
ning on values and ethics and the other on Friday morn
ing on AIDS. The Executive Council, the administrative
arm of the fraternity, w^ill be holding its summer
meeting
during the Convention, as vwll the Alumni Advisory Board
and the Undergraduate Advisory Board.

WHY WASHINGTON, D.C?

Actually, the Convention is being held this year in
Arlington, Virginia, which is somewhat of a departure
from the custom of a chapter hosting the annual event
on its
campus. Washington, D.C. was chosen for several
reasons, not the least of which is the large contingent of
Psi U alumni living in the D.C. area who might have
the opportunity to attend their first convention (or their
first in many years). The Hyatt Arlington in Rosslyn,
Virginia, will be the site of all activities. Among its many
advantages are its excellent location (close proximity to
Georgetown and a Metro stop), relatively small size (a

100-person convention like ours can get lost in some of
the very large hotel/convention centers), superb meeting
and dining facilities, and, perhaps most importantly, as
surance of high quality service from its general
manager,
Rich Carlson, Epsilon Nu '69.
